base_layout_binding.excluded_reason: The complete external predictor is the environment in the v6 source-proved component boundary and is intentionally not a sparse component-state partition.

canonicalization.inherited_rule: Every base tensor, ordinal, dtype, dimension, logical byte, padding rule, strided-slab rule, and family order is exactly the bound v5 phase-1 layout; it is not restated or renumbered here.
canonicalization.wrapper_order: The eleven records below have exact contiguous tensor ordinals 0 through 10 in listed order.
canonicalization.signed_integer_rule: Every source int is bit-cast without arithmetic conversion to canonical uint32 little-endian bits.
canonicalization.float_rule: Every finite source float is serialized as its exact IEEE-754 binary32 bit pattern in little-endian order.
canonicalization.pointer_rule: No pointer, address, capacity, allocator padding, or object padding is hashed. The Lstm output-bias pointer is represented only by the canonical uint8 selector output_bias_active after its permitted referent is checked.
canonicalization.fixed_storage_rule: The v6 observability source must construct folded_bias_ at exactly vocab_size entries initialized to positive zero even before the first SetOutputBias call. This allocation-only change must pass observer-off/on probability neutrality.

tensors.name: byte_mixer.output_bias_active
tensors.source: 0 when Lstm::out_bias_ is null; 1 only when it equals the first element of ByteMixer::folded_bias_

source_invariants: ByteModel::probs_.size(), ByteMixer::byte_map_.size(), ByteMixer::inputs_.size(), and ByteMixer::folded_bias_.size() each equal 256.
ByteMixer::num_models_ equals 1 and ByteMixer::vocab_size_ equals 256; these immutable build/configuration facts are metadata-bound rather than state tensors.
Every byte_map_ value is in [0,255], every source int is exactly 32 bits, and every serialized float is finite.
Lstm::out_bias_ is either null or exactly aliases ByteMixer::folded_bias_[0]; any other referent aborts observation.
The referenced Predictor bit context and vocabulary are environment inputs/configuration, not owned component state.

The diagnostic globals lstmpr and lstmex are excluded because the bound source never reads them after assignment; byte_mixer_output is excluded because every assigned value is already in the complete longitudinal boundary-output digest.

derived_totals.bound_rule: maximum_tree_nodes is the sum over tensors of 2*leaves-1; all wrapper tensors have one leaf.

component_root.preimage: domain, uint32LE partition_count=6, then for partition codes 1,2,3,4,6,7 in that order: partition_code uint8, three reserved zero bytes, partition_root_sha256[32].
component_root.base_partition_roots: Use the v1 metadata, leaf, node, lone-node, tensor, and partition digest rules without modification so the five base partition roots remain definitionally stable.
component_root.wrapper_partition_root: Use the same v1 rules with partition_code=7 and exact wrapper ordinals above.
component_root.rebuild_rule: At each of the six sparse coordinates, rebuild every one of the 141 tensor roots and all six partition roots from canonical logical bytes; no dirty tracking or incremental root is accepted.
component_root.role: Diagnostic localization and repeat evidence only. Longitudinal component-output and final-probability digests, payloads, inverses, and the source-interface proof carry the P/K noninterference claim.
